Omar Farooq  
Email: omar.farooq@techcorpinnovations.com | Phone: +44 7700 123456 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/omarfarooq | GitHub: github.com/omarfarooq  

A recent graduate with hands-on experience in full-stack development, currently contributing to enterprise applications at TechCorp Innovations. Focused on building scalable solutions using modern tools and methodologies, with a particular interest in automating workflows and improving system reliability.  

Technical Skills  
Proficient in a range of technologies including GitLab CI for continuous integration, Kubernetes for container orchestration, and Python for scripting. Familiar with Terraform for infrastructure as code. Regularly use Docker to containerize applications, ensuring consistent environments across development and production. Experienced in JavaScript for both frontend and backend logic, with a focus on Node.js for server-side operations. Developed REST APIs to facilitate communication between microservices, and leveraged PostgreSQL for robust data management. Contributed to React-based interfaces that prioritize user interaction and performance.  

Professional Experience  
Developer Intern, TechCorp Innovations (2023)  
Supported the development of a customer-facing platform by implementing REST APIs for data synchronization between frontend and backend systems. Collaborated on automating deployment pipelines using GitLab CI, reducing manual steps in the release process. Assisted in setting up Docker containers for local development environments, ensuring consistency across team workflows.  

Junior Full-Stack Developer, TechCorp Innovations (2024)  
Designed and deployed a microservices-based application using Node.js for backend logic and React for the frontend. Integrated PostgreSQL as the primary database, optimizing query performance for real-time data retrieval. Participated in setting up Kubernetes clusters to manage containerized services, improving scalability and fault tolerance. Developed custom scripts in Python to automate data processing tasks, reducing manual effort by approximately 30%.  

Education  
BSc in Computer Science, University of London (2023)  
Completed a degree with a focus on software engineering principles and distributed systems, providing a solid foundation for full-stack development.  

Projects  
Task Management Platform  
Built a web application using React for the frontend, Node.js for the backend, and PostgreSQL for data storage. Implemented REST APIs to enable seamless communication between client and server, with Docker used to containerize the application for deployment.  

CI/CD Automation Pipeline  
Contributed to the setup of GitLab CI pipelines to automate testing and deployment processes. Utilized Docker to create consistent environments for CI/CD stages, ensuring reliable builds and reducing deployment errors.  

Enterprise Dashboard  
Developed a data visualization dashboard using React and REST APIs, integrating data from PostgreSQL databases to provide actionable insights for business users.
